1.en_consolidated_definition: Foam rubber, treated latex or synthetic product. An industrial item that is spongy and soft, used for seats, mattresses, etc. This term is an unadapted Anglicism commonly used. Those things that are thrown away, the rings they call them, have three to four inches of foam rubber. That foam protects them. In other words, it's not a sport that...; to such an extreme that neither the Olympics nor a university include it
